The Director

Made by someone who ships this daily

I'm Steve Nooshinfar — a creative director in Dubai working in high-end cinematic storytelling, motion design, 3D advertising and AI-driven production.

These books aren't a survey of tools. They're the exact process I use to take a brief from a blank page to a finished, delivered film — written down, with the real projects attached.

Trained through School of Motion, Rebelway and Motion Design School; a background running creative teams as an animation supervisor. This is the playbook I wish I'd had.
